entries.en: Ancrum unfolded the damp map and asked where the footbridge had been.
entries.zh: 安克拉姆展开潮湿的地图，问那座人行桥原先在哪里。

entries.en: The ancylite specimen arrived wrapped separately from the other minerals.
entries.zh: 那块碳酸锶铈矿标本送到时，与其他矿物分开包着。

entries.en: The interpreter helped him describe his concerns about ancylostomiasis to the doctor.
entries.zh: 口译员帮助他向医生说明自己对钩虫病的担忧。

entries.en: Andal kept a notebook of the songs her grandmother remembered.
entries.zh: 安达尔用一本笔记本记录祖母记得的那些歌。

entries.en: We found Andel repairing a puncture outside the bicycle shop.
entries.zh: 我们发现安德尔正在自行车店外补胎。

entries.en: Andell would rather mend the old shelf than order a new one.
entries.zh: 安德尔宁愿修好旧架子，也不愿订购一个新的。

entries.en: The envelope addressed to Andelman contained only a faded photograph.
entries.zh: 寄给安德尔曼的信封里只有一张褪色的照片。

entries.en: Ander lowered the blind before turning on the projector.
entries.zh: 安德先放下了百叶帘，然后才打开投影机。

entries.en: Anderman recognised the tune but could not name the singer.
entries.zh: 安德曼认出了曲调，却说不出歌手的名字。

entries.en: A photograph of the andersonite specimen showed the damaged corner clearly.
entries.zh: 水钠钙铀矿标本的照片清楚地显示了受损的一角。

entries.en: Andersons asked for a quieter room away from the rehearsal hall.
entries.zh: 安德松斯想要一间远离排练厅的安静房间。

entries.en: Andia brought a thermos because the café would not open until noon.
entries.zh: 安迪亚带了一个保温瓶，因为咖啡馆中午才开门。

entries.en: The scarf Andina had knitted was just the colour I wanted.
entries.zh: 安迪纳织的那条围巾正是我想要的颜色。

entries.en: Andis checked the timetable again when the bus failed to appear.
entries.zh: 公交车迟迟不来，安迪斯又核对了一遍时刻表。

entries.en: When the line stopped, the supervisor looked up at the andon.
entries.zh: 生产线停下时，主管抬头看向安灯。

entries.en: Andoni offered to keep the spare suitcase until we returned.
entries.zh: 安多尼主动提出替我们保管备用行李箱，等我们回来。

entries.en: Andor moved the microphone so the speaker could see the audience.
entries.zh: 安多尔挪开麦克风，让发言者能够看见听众。

entries.en: She ordered an andouillette while I chose the vegetable tart.
entries.zh: 她点了一根内脏香肠，我则选了蔬菜挞。

entries.en: Andr lent us a trolley for the boxes of donated books.
entries.zh: 安德尔借给我们一辆手推车，用来搬那些捐赠的书。

entries.en: Andrades left room on the wall for the missing portrait.
entries.zh: 安德拉德斯在墙上为那幅缺失的肖像留出了位置。

entries.en: The note from Andrae explained why the workshop had moved upstairs.
entries.zh: 安德烈的便条解释了工作坊搬到楼上的原因。

entries.en: Her study of andragogy changed how she planned classes for adult learners.
entries.zh: 对成人教育学的研究改变了她为成年学习者安排课程的方式。

entries.en: Andranik arrived with fresh bread just as we finished making soup.
entries.zh: 我们刚做好汤，安德拉尼克就带着新鲜面包到了。

entries.en: Andreadis spotted the missing page before we sent the manuscript away.
entries.zh: 我们寄出稿件之前，安德烈亚季斯发现少了一页。

entries.en: Andreae suggested drawing a plan before moving any of the furniture.
entries.zh: 安德烈埃建议先画一张平面图，再移动家具。

entries.en: Andrean held the torch while I searched beneath the loose floorboard.
entries.zh: 我在松动的地板下面寻找时，安德烈安举着手电筒。

entries.en: Andreani had saved enough fabric to replace the torn lining.
entries.zh: 安德烈亚尼留下的布料足够更换破损的衬里。

entries.en: Andreasen preferred the smaller flat because it overlooked the park.
entries.zh: 安德烈亚森更喜欢那套较小的公寓，因为它能俯瞰公园。

entries.en: We waited for Andreassen beside the fountain rather than at the gate.
entries.zh: 我们在喷泉旁等安德烈亚森，而不是在大门口等。

entries.en: Andree wrapped the fragile cups in yesterday's newspaper.
entries.zh: 安德烈用昨天的报纸包好那些易碎的杯子。

entries.en: Andreea promised to return the camera before our afternoon walk.
entries.zh: 安德烈亚答应在我们下午散步前归还相机。

entries.en: The spare part Andreis needed was smaller than a shirt button.
entries.zh: 安德烈斯需要的那个备用零件比衬衫纽扣还小。

entries.en: Andrej kept the parcel upright throughout the crowded tram journey.
entries.zh: 电车里很拥挤，安德烈一路都让包裹保持直立。

entries.en: Andrejs could hear applause from the hall while waiting in the corridor.
entries.zh: 安德烈斯在走廊等候时，能听见大厅里的掌声。

entries.en: Andreo needed a second pair of hands to hang the heavy mirror.
entries.zh: 安德烈奥需要有人搭把手，才能挂起那面沉重的镜子。

entries.en: Andreotta noticed that the address on the parcel was incomplete.
entries.zh: 安德烈奥塔注意到包裹上的地址没有写全。

entries.en: Andresen photographed the assembled shelves before taking them apart.
entries.zh: 安德烈森在拆开组装好的架子前，先给它们拍了照。

entries.en: Andress put a folded towel beneath the leaking flowerpot.
entries.zh: 安德烈斯在漏水的花盆下面垫了一条折好的毛巾。

entries.en: Andreu asked whether the narrow lane led back to the harbour.
entries.zh: 安德鲁问那条狭窄的小巷是否通回港口。

entries.meaningZh: 安德列耶夫〔俄国作家名〕
entries.en: Her essay compared Andreyev's stories with the plays we had read.
entries.zh: 她的论文把安德列耶夫的故事与我们读过的戏剧作了比较。

entries.en: Andria stayed behind to help fold the chairs after the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览结束后，安德里亚留下来帮忙折叠椅子。

entries.en: Andrian counted the tickets twice before handing them to the steward.
entries.zh: 安德里安把票数了两遍，才交给工作人员。

entries.en: Andriano pinned a sample of the curtain fabric beside the window.
entries.zh: 安德里亚诺在窗边别上了一块窗帘布样。

entries.en: Andrich read the faded inscription aloud while we copied the letters.
entries.zh: 安德里克大声读出模糊的铭文，我们则抄下那些字母。

entries.en: Andrieu brought the missing sketchbook to our next meeting.
entries.zh: 下次见面时，安德里厄带来了那本先前找不到的速写本。

entries.en: Andris was halfway through mending the fence when the rain began.
entries.zh: 开始下雨时，安德里斯才把篱笆修到一半。

entries.en: Andrius left enough space between the tables for the trolley.
entries.zh: 安德留斯在桌子之间留出了足够手推车通过的空间。

entries.en: Andriy recognised the handwriting on the back of the photograph.
entries.zh: 安德里认出了照片背面的笔迹。

entries.en: The essay criticised an androcracy that excluded women from every public decision.
entries.zh: 论文批评了一种将女性排除在一切公共决策之外的男性统治。

entries.en: The diagram showed an androgamete beside the much larger female gamete.
entries.zh: 图中画着一个雄配子，旁边是大得多的雌配子。

entries.en: A second analyst checked the andrographin measurements before the results were compared.
entries.zh: 比较结果之前，另一名分析员核查了穿心莲黄酮的测量数据。

entries.en: The library moved its andrology journals to make room for new shelves.
entries.zh: 图书馆搬动了男科学期刊，为新架子腾出空间。

entries.en: Andron replaced the cracked pane before the next rehearsal.
entries.zh: 安德龙在下一次排练前更换了那块破裂的窗玻璃。

entries.en: Andronicus asked us to leave the doorway clear for the delivery.
entries.zh: 安德罗尼柯请我们把门口空出来，以便送货。

entries.en: Andronov noticed the uneven table and slipped a card beneath one leg.
entries.zh: 安德罗诺夫发现桌子不平，就在一条桌腿下塞了一张卡片。

entries.en: The discussion of andropause left him with questions for his doctor.
entries.zh: 关于男性更年期的讨论让他产生了一些想向医生询问的问题。

entries.en: Visitors gathered around the androsphinx near the museum entrance.
entries.zh: 参观者聚集在博物馆入口附近的狮身人头像周围。

entries.en: Each androsporangium was sketched before the microscope slide was moved.
entries.zh: 每个雄孢子囊都画好了草图，之后才移动载玻片。

entries.en: The corrected calculation included the androstane recovered from the second sample.
entries.zh: 更正后的计算计入了从第二份样品中回收的雄甾烷。

entries.en: Andru returned the borrowed saw with a new blade fitted.
entries.zh: 安德鲁归还借来的锯子时，已经装好了一片新锯条。

entries.en: Andrzej kept a copy of the route in his coat pocket.
entries.zh: 安杰伊在外套口袋里留了一份路线图。

entries.en: Andrzejewski asked the choir to repeat the final verse more quietly.
entries.zh: 安杰耶夫斯基请合唱团把最后一段再轻声唱一遍。

entries.en: The anecdotage contains several stories about the town's vanished theatres.
entries.zh: 这部轶事集里有几个关于镇上已消失剧院的故事。

entries.en: His anecdotalism entertained the visitors but delayed every item on the agenda.
entries.zh: 他爱谈轶事的习惯让来客听得开心，却耽误了日程上的每一项活动。

entries.en: A gifted anecdotalist, she could make an ordinary train journey sound extraordinary.
entries.zh: 她很擅长讲轶事，能把一次普通的火车旅行讲得精彩非凡。

entries.en: Anel found the lost glove caught between two seats.
entries.zh: 阿内尔发现那只丢失的手套卡在两个座位之间。

entries.en: The actor drew an anelace from beneath his cloak during the final scene.
entries.zh: 在最后一场戏中，演员从斗篷下面拔出了一把双刃短剑。

entries.en: The researchers measured anelasticity before comparing the two metal samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员先测量了滞弹性，然后才比较那两份金属样品。

entries.en: Anelli saved the damaged frame because its carved corners were still intact.
entries.zh: 阿内利保留了那个受损的画框，因为雕花的四角仍然完好。

entries.en: The lesson on anemochory compared seeds collected from three different plants.
entries.zh: 那堂关于风力散布的课比较了从三种不同植物上收集的种子。

entries.en: A tear across the anemogram obscured the readings from the previous afternoon.
entries.zh: 风速记录图上有一道裂口，遮住了前一天下午的读数。

entries.en: The anemograph stopped recording shortly before the backup power failed.
entries.zh: 备用电源失效前不久，风速记录仪停止了记录。

entries.en: Her interest in anemology began while she worked at a coastal weather station.
entries.zh: 她在海边气象站工作时，开始对测风学产生兴趣。

entries.en: They compared the old anemometrograph with the instrument installed last spring.
entries.zh: 他们把那台旧记风仪与去年春天安装的仪器作了比较。

entries.en: Our discussion of anemophily continued after the botany class had ended.
entries.zh: 植物学课结束后，我们还在继续讨论风媒传粉。

entries.en: The anemoscope above the shed was barely visible through the mist.
entries.zh: 棚屋上方的风向仪在雾中几乎看不清。

entries.en: The carpenter examined the anemosis before choosing another piece of timber.
entries.zh: 木匠检查了年轮分离的情况，随后选用了另一块木料。

entries.en: Aner remembered where the spare hinges had been stored.
entries.zh: 阿纳记得备用铰链存放在哪里。

entries.en: Aneta waited until the room was quiet before beginning the story.
entries.zh: 阿内塔等房间安静下来，才开始讲故事。

entries.en: The anethol results were kept separate until the instrument had been recalibrated.
entries.zh: 仪器重新校准之前，茴香脑的结果一直单独保存着。

entries.en: The archive kept the unopened aneurine bottle with the other pharmacy donations.
entries.zh: 档案保管部门把未开封的硫胺素瓶与其他捐赠的药学藏品放在一起。

entries.en: Anfa checked the cupboard twice before borrowing another saucepan.
entries.zh: 安法把橱柜检查了两遍，才去借另一个长柄锅。

entries.en: The map followed the river's anfractuosities through the marsh.
entries.zh: 地图标出了河流穿过沼泽时弯弯曲曲的水道。

entries.meaningZh: 因纽特人的萨满〔民族志用语〕
entries.en: In the tale, an angakok asks the visitors to wait outside.
entries.zh: 故事中，一位因纽特萨满请来访者在外面等候。

entries.en: Her essay on angary compared two historical disputes without treating every seizure as lawful.
entries.zh: 她关于征用权的论文比较了两场历史纠纷，并未把一切征收都视为合法。

entries.meaningZh: 因纽特人的萨满〔angakok 的异形〕
entries.en: The storyteller introduced an angekok before describing the travellers' arrival.
entries.zh: 讲故事的人先介绍了一位因纽特萨满，随后才讲到旅行者到来的情节。

entries.en: An angel-food cake stood beside the bowl of fresh strawberries.
entries.zh: 一只白蛋糕放在那碗新鲜草莓旁边。

entries.en: Angelas changed the seat covers while we cleaned the wooden table.
entries.zh: 我们清洁木桌时，安赫拉斯更换了椅套。

entries.en: Angele found enough thread to finish the embroidered border.
entries.zh: 安吉拉找到了足够的线，能把那道刺绣花边绣完。

entries.en: A painted angelet with silver wings decorated the corner of the frame.
entries.zh: 画框的一角装饰着一个画有银色翅膀的小天使。

entries.en: Angelicus set the wet umbrellas in a stand by the door.
entries.zh: 安杰利卡斯把湿雨伞放进门旁的伞架里。

entries.en: Angelika copied the recipe before returning the notebook to her neighbour.
entries.zh: 安格莉卡抄好食谱，才把笔记本还给邻居。

entries.en: Angelini asked the driver to stop near the covered market.
entries.zh: 安杰利尼请司机在有顶棚的市场附近停车。

entries.en: Angelis carried the folding screen upstairs without scratching the painted wall.
entries.zh: 安杰利斯把折叠屏风搬上了楼，没有刮到刷过漆的墙。

entries.en: Angelle kept the window open while the freshly painted shelves dried.
entries.zh: 新刷漆的架子晾干时，安热勒一直开着窗户。

entries.en: The lecturer distinguished angelolatry from the mere depiction of angels in paintings.
entries.zh: 讲师区分了天使崇拜与仅在画作中描绘天使这两件事。

entries.en: The painting shows an angelophany above the sleeping traveller.
entries.zh: 这幅画描绘了一位天使显现在熟睡的旅行者上方。

entries.en: Angelos rearranged the chairs so everyone could see the demonstration.
entries.zh: 安耶洛斯重新摆放椅子，让每个人都能看见演示。

entries.en: Anghel took a photograph of the sign before it was removed.
entries.zh: 安格尔在那块牌子被拆走之前给它拍了照。

entries.en: Angi waited by the staircase with the parcel we had forgotten.
entries.zh: 安吉带着我们忘拿的包裹在楼梯旁等候。

entries.en: He wanted a clearer explanation of the angialgia discussed at his appointment.
entries.zh: 他希望进一步弄清楚就诊时讨论到的血管痛。

entries.en: The storm uprooted an angico beside the nursery's entrance.
entries.zh: 暴风雨把苗圃入口旁的一棵巴西树胶树连根拔起。

entries.en: Angier found a dry place beneath the awning for our bags.
entries.zh: 安吉尔在遮阳篷下面为我们的包找到了一个干燥的地方。

entries.en: Angiolini marked the damaged tiles before the workers began lifting them.
entries.zh: 工人动手撬瓷砖之前，安焦利尼标出了那些损坏的瓷砖。

entries.en: The pathologist requested another image of the angiolipoleiomyoma before the case meeting.
entries.zh: 病例讨论会之前，病理医生要求再提供一张血管脂肪平滑肌瘤的图像。

entries.en: The photograph showed two angiolipomas beside the ruler used for scale.
entries.zh: 照片里，用作比例尺的直尺旁边有两个血管脂肪瘤。

entries.en: Her follow-up appointment concerning angiolymphitis was moved to the following week.
entries.zh: 她关于淋巴管炎的复诊被改到了下一周。

entries.en: The discussion of angiosclerosis continued after the visiting lecturer had left.
entries.zh: 来访讲师离开后，关于血管硬化的讨论仍在继续。

entries.en: The angiostatin measurements differed between the two samples, prompting another check of the records.
entries.zh: 两份样品中的血管抑素测量结果不同，促使他们再次核对记录。

entries.en: The consent form for the proposed angiostomy had not yet been signed.
entries.zh: 拟议中的血管造口术，其同意书还没有签署。

entries.en: He brought his earlier records to the appointment concerning angitis.
entries.zh: 他带着以前的记录，前去接受关于血管炎的诊察。

entries.en: An anglepod grew beside the greenhouse where the old fence had stood.
entries.zh: 原先立着旧篱笆的温室旁边，长着一株角荚植物。

entries.en: Our friends in Angleton sent a photograph of their newly planted garden.
entries.zh: 我们在安格勒顿的朋友寄来了一张新栽种花园的照片。

entries.en: The essay traced the anglicization of several names without assuming that their older forms disappeared.
entries.zh: 论文追溯了几个名字的英语化过程，但没有认定它们较早的形式已经消失。

entries.en: Anglin sorted the photographs by date before placing them in the album.
entries.zh: 安格林先按日期整理照片，然后才把它们放进相册。

entries.en: An Anglo-Indian in our reading group recommended a collection of family memoirs.
entries.zh: 我们读书小组里的一位英印混血者推荐了一部家庭回忆录集。

entries.en: Angrand needed a larger sheet to copy the entire floor plan.
entries.zh: 安格朗需要一张更大的纸，才能把整张楼层平面图抄下来。

entries.en: Anguiano moved the coat rack so the door could open fully.
entries.zh: 安吉亚诺挪开衣帽架，让门能完全打开。

entries.en: Anguis checked each pocket before leaving the borrowed coat in the cloakroom.
entries.zh: 安吉斯把借来的外套放进衣帽间之前，检查了每个口袋。

entries.en: The angulator was removed from the workbench while its damaged mount was replaced.
entries.zh: 更换损坏的支座时，角度转换仪被从工作台上移开了。

entries.en: Angulo put the returned books on a separate shelf behind the desk.
entries.zh: 安古洛把归还的书放在书桌后面一个单独的架子上。

entries.en: The student compared the angulometer reading with the angle drawn on the plan.
entries.zh: 那个学生把测角器的读数与图纸上画出的角度作了比较。

entries.en: The laboratory postponed the anhalidine comparison until both instruments were available.
entries.zh: 实验室推迟了安哈定的比较，等两台仪器都能使用时再进行。

entries.en: The model ignored anharmonicity, which became important in the later comparison.
entries.zh: 那个模型忽略了非谐性，而这一点在后续比较中变得重要起来。

entries.en: Anheuser spread the drawings across the counter while we measured the shelves.
entries.zh: 我们测量架子时，安霍伊泽把图纸摊在柜台上。

entries.en: The photographer sent Anheuser-Busch a corrected invoice for the completed assignment.
entries.zh: 摄影师就已完成的工作向安海斯布希寄去了一份更正后的发票。

entries.en: The case discussion concerning anhydremia was postponed until the interpreter arrived.
entries.zh: 关于缺水血症的病例讨论被推迟了，等口译员到达后再进行。

entries.en: The final report kept the anhydroalkannin results separate from the preliminary measurements.
entries.zh: 最终报告将去水异紫草素的结果与初步测量数据分开列出。

entries.en: Her letter described the anhypnosis that had troubled her during the journey.
entries.zh: 她在信中描述了旅途中困扰她的失眠。

entries.en: Ania took the unfinished scarf home so she could mend its loose border.
entries.zh: 阿尼娅把尚未完成的围巾带回家，以便修补松散的边缘。

entries.en: Aniak made a small sketch to show us where the path divided.
entries.zh: 阿尼亚克画了一幅简图，告诉我们小路在哪里分岔。

entries.en: Anibal kept a seat for the visitor who had gone to fetch water.
entries.zh: 阿尼巴尔给去取水的那位来客留了一个座位。

entries.en: Anica finished packing the fragile bowls before the taxi arrived.
entries.zh: 出租车到达之前，阿妮卡就把那些易碎的碗装好了。

entries.en: The seminar discussed anicca through changing seasons rather than abstract definitions alone.
entries.zh: 研讨会借助四季变化来讨论无常，而不只是讲抽象定义。

entries.en: Aniceto fetched a cushion for the chair beside the window.
entries.zh: 阿尼塞托为窗边的那把椅子取来一个坐垫。

entries.en: The exhibition explored aniconism without treating every undecorated object as a religious statement.
entries.zh: 展览探讨了无偶像论，但没有把每件未经装饰的物品都视为宗教表态。

entries.meaningZh: 灌溉水坝〔印度南部用语〕
entries.en: The farmers inspected the anicut after the heavy rain had eased.
entries.zh: 大雨减弱后，农民们检查了那座灌溉水坝。
